name: hy-workflow-mcp
description: MCP server enforcing a 9-phase closed-loop workflow for LLM-assisted development

scripts.lint:contract: npm run build && npm run lint:contract:built
scripts.test:unit: for f in test/unit/*.ts; do npx tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:e2e: for f in test/e2e/*.ts; do npx tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:contract: for f in test/contract/*.ts; do npx tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:contract
